decision: Approve bounded transition-settling before viewport measurement. Existing two-frame helper actually waits for two scheduled animation frames plus350ms; the added wait requires any running main-column CSS transition to complete and mobile margin to settle to zero, with a5-second timeout. Every existing measurement, error assertion, sampled width and reader test remains byte-identical.
limits: This is exact source/syntax review; no fresh browser pass is asserted. Scheduled animation frames do not prove a paint occurs in every browser state.
A transition or mobile margin that never reaches the expected state still fails after the bounded timeout; the change does not waive or remove any overflow/title/assertion check.
Site HTML/CSS and inventory are unchanged by this QA edit.
